candidates.description: This feature vector activates strongly on specific Hindi character n-grams and sub-word tokens.
This vector represents sub-word tokens and numerals common in Hindi and Devanagari script text processing.
This vector activates strongly for instances of the Devanagari retroflex sibilant consonant 'ष' and its various vowel-modified syllable forms.
This vector represents subword fragments and character combinations spanning multiple distinct scripts.
This vector activates for characters, subwords, and common roots in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates on Hindi vowel sign and dependent vowel matra characters combined with a comma punctuation mark.
This vector represents the Devanagari retroflex consonants and common dependent vowel markers used in Hindi script.
This vector represents subword tokens and characters specific to the Nepali language script and text encoding.
This vector represents common Hindi word suffixes and letter clusters involving the consonant 'र' (ra).
This feature vector activates strongly for Hindi and Greek characters, specifically representing vowel signs, dependent vowel modifiers, and standalone vowels in these scripts.
